newsitem.title: UK: UK refers PacifiCorp -Energy to MMC.
newsitem.headline: UK refers PacifiCorp -Energy to MMC.

text.p: Britain's department of trade and industry said on Friday it had decided to refer the planned acquisition of the Energy Group Plc by U.S.-based PacifiCorp to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
"I have concerns over whether it will be possible to maintain adequate regulatory control over the merged company," trade and industry secretary Margaret Beckett said.
The DTI's referral came two days after PacifiCorp said it had received acceptances representing 61.6 percent of Energy under its agreed 3.7 billion pounds ($6.1 billion) bid for the company.
The share price of Energy slid 31-1/2 pence to 619 1/2p moments after the announcement was made.

Commenting on the referral, Beckett said:"...I shall continue to examine mergers on a case-by-case basis and where, as here, I believe that as part of a wider public interest scrutiny, important regulatory issues are raised, I may decide that a reference is warranted".
Earlier this month, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission made a second request for information on the deal as part of its routine review of the proposed merger.
